propositions: The deployed Gerrit review bot must load and execute the review-phase-boundaries criterion from the rebar repository through the real four-pass pipeline to prove end-to-end project-criterion execution, which offline fixtures cannot validate.

A four-patchset advisory-only dogfood probe must demonstrate that the criterion correctly identifies review phase boundaries, emits no finding on valid discovery/evidence refinement, and produces grounded Pass-2 and Pass-3 attributes only for stimuli that name instructed phase, action, and owner.

The predeclared RP-F2 FIRE balanced-corpus case must produce a project-attributed advisory finding with reviewer_id code-review-project-review-phase-boundaries and criteria project.review-phase-boundaries, establishing that the deployed seam executes project-criterion logic correctly.

The cleaned final patchset removes invalid negative directives, retains only phase-compliant instructions, emits no project-criterion finding, and must be the sole dogfood revision submitted to main with blocking disabled and threshold 0.90 unchanged.
A future separately-reviewed data-backed ticket must decide whether to enable blocking; this dogfood is observational and does not change the rubric or promotion posture.
